references.text: The fulfillment of the command to make a gold plate with the inscription 'Holy to the Lord'
Continuation of the instructions regarding the gold plate, its placement on the turban, and its function
Moses places the gold plate on Aaron's turban at the consecration of the priesthood
The prophecy that 'Holy to the Lord' will be written on the bells of horses in the messianic age
The same technique of seal engraving (פִּתּוּחֵי חֹתָם) is used on the onyx stones
The same engraving technique is used on the stones of the breastpiece
In the new Jerusalem, God's name will be written on the foreheads of believers, reflecting the priest's holy plate
